title: Keep Me a Light
role: A bonus track, not yet in the game: the soundtrack's song. Sung, orchestral, with layered harmonies and a choir; somewhere it could play is the end of a won run, over the credits.
theme: Someone going down to the root of a broken world, promising to come home: a light kept in the window above, the song they share, every word they were taught a little piece of light. The chorus opens on the soundtrack's motif (1 5 1 b3 2 1), and the last chorus rises a whole step into D minor, the soundtrack's home key, where it is the very melody of Salvage Skirmish.
reference: The player's request: the feel of the vocal theme of a PlayStation role-playing game they loved as a child (The Legend of Dragoon's 'If You Still Believe', by Dennis Martin, sung by Elsa Raven, which sources give as C minor at about 84 BPM), 'the semi-harmonic and orchestral vocals'. Nothing of it is used: the melody, the words and the chords are this track's own; only the kind of song is shared (a slow minor-key ballad for a female voice, harmonies and a choir over an orchestra).
key: C minor, the last chorus in D minor
form: silence 1, intro 4 (the chorus's first line on a high solo instrument), verse 9 (low and close, a pickup bar), pre-chorus 4 (climbing to the leading tone), chorus 8 (the motif), interlude 3 (a solo string instrument), verse 9, pre-chorus 4, chorus 8, bridge 8 (falling then rising, pivoting through Bb and Gm to A), chorus 10 (a whole step up, with a tag), outro 4 (the motif high, ending on D major)
style: symphonic power ballad, cinematic orchestral pop, emotional female vocal, clear soaring soprano lead, lush layered vocal harmonies, ethereal choir, grand piano, sweeping string orchestra, harp, french horns, timpani swells, bittersweet and hopeful, English, C minor, 80 BPM
lyrics:
[Verse]
Beneath the rust and ashes
Beneath the sleeping stone
I keep the spark you gave me
So I never walk alone

[Pre-Chorus]
And though the night is long
I hear you in the song

[Chorus]
Keep me a light in the window
Sing me the song that we know
Down where the old roots are sleeping
I will come home, I will come home

[Verse]
And line by line I write it
A spell against the night
And every word you taught me
Is a little piece of light

[Pre-Chorus]
And though the way is long
I hear you in the song

[Chorus]
Keep me a light in the window
Sing me the song that we know
Down where the old roots are sleeping
I will come home, I will come home

[Bridge]
If I should fall
If every star goes out
Sing me back through the silence
Sing me home

[Chorus]
Keep me a light in the window
Sing me the song that we know
Down where the old roots are sleeping
I will come home, I will come home
I will come home
